name: TreeView
description: A hierarchical tree structure component with expand/collapse functionality. Supports nested nodes, selection state, and keyboard navigation.

notes: The root element uses role='tree' and child items use role='treeitem'.
Expandable nodes use aria-expanded to communicate state.
Selected nodes use aria-selected to communicate selection.
Toggle buttons use Enter and Space to expand/collapse nodes.
Focus indicator uses var(--color-border-focus) on interactive nodes.

items.description: REQUIRED. Array of tree node objects. Each node has id, label, optional children, and optional isExpanded.

onToggle.description: Callback fired when a node's expand/collapse state is toggled.

onSelect.description: Callback fired when a node is selected.

selectedId.description: The id of the currently selected node.

className.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element.

do: Provide meaningful labels for each tree node.
Use onToggle to manage expand/collapse state externally.
Use selectedId and onSelect for controlled selection.
Keep tree depth reasonable for usability — consider alternative patterns for deeply nested data.
dont: Do not use TreeView for flat lists — use List instead.
Do not place complex interactive widgets inside node labels.
Do not create circular parent-child references in the items array.
